name: Outside-In
mission: Evidence-backed company profiles from public signals.
flowAlt: Data flow: a company domain goes to six collectors (tech, pricing, careers, changelog, DNS, reviews), and every request they make passes one polite HTTP gate that honours robots.txt and a per-host rate limit. Each observation becomes an evidence item with an id, a source URL and an excerpt. Findings are written by offline rules, or by Claude when a key is set, and code drops any finding without a valid evidence id and sets or caps its confidence from the evidence. The result is report.md for people and report.json for programs.

nodes: Claude if a key is set
